recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in dark, textured techwear stands before a complex industrial lattice structure. The scene is bisected by a thick horizontal black band containing high-gloss, 3D metallic lettering. The background features a gradient sky transitioning from a cool cyan at the top to a warm orange sunset at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a horizontal typographic bar
Contrast between organic human form and rigid industrial geometry
Color temperature split between cyan upper half and orange lower half
Metallic text texture reflecting the ambient light of the environment
coreInvariants: Horizontal black banner spanning the full width
Industrial lattice or radio tower background elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central vertical alignment, partially obscured by the middle banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick black horizontal banner serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the metallic title, moves up to the subject's face, then down through the industrial background to the secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the upper right and lower left provides breathing room against the dense lattice structures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black in the central banner and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan blue in the upper sky and warm orange in the lower horizon.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Chrome silver in the 3D lettering and a thin yellow horizontal divider line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky gradients contrasted with desaturated, high-value metallic reflections.

letterConstructionRules: Squared-off corners and uniform stroke weight
Internal horizontal cut-outs in characters like 'A' or 'E'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical characters styled to match the width and blocky nature of the alpha characters
Horizontal bars in 'E' and 'S' are perfectly parallel and equal in length
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or geometric sans for secondary text to maintain the technical, industrial feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the Y2K industrial aesthetic and wide proportions.
Provides the necessary square-jawed, technical look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in black leather-like techwear standing in front of a tall, complex metal lattice radio tower. The background is a split-tone sky with cyan on top and orange sunset on the bottom. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thick black horizontal bar across the middle. Inside the bar, place large 3D chrome-textured text in an ultra-wide geometric sans-serif. Add a secondary line of smaller text below it, separated by thin yellow horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered within a black horizontal band?
Does the sky transition from blue to orange?
Is the typography rendered with a 3D metallic effect?
Is the central figure wearing dark, industrial clothing?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the metal lattice structure
Thickness of the 3D bevel on the text
Subject's pose and specific techwear style
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Smooth color gradients in the sky
Sharp focus on the subject and foreground lattice

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horizontal bar is perfectly straight.
Check that the chrome texture reflects the sky colors.
Verify the text is ultra-wide and geometric.
Confirm the industrial tower looks structural and complex.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Industrial/Tech Subject] + [Split-Tone Cyan/Orange Sky] + [Central Black Banner] + [3D Chrome Extended Typography] to create a Y2K-era futuristic aesthetic.
